title: Grant Analyst Workbench customer commissioning

task.name: Commission complete grant analysis, Learning and study receiving
task.purpose: Give a responsible customer reviewer one source-bound editable workflow from complete publisher editions and actual commissioned scope through explicit decisions, Learning actions, evidence, report releases and independent receiving.
task.request: Receive the existing Workshare and Installation selections. Identify customer, reviewer, source owner, actual original operation and equipped receiver. Prepare the complete privately supplied application/commission source under a literal authority; public wrappers remain separate. Adopt existing original workspaces and completed Learning/study results without combining unrelated histories. Operate source imports, codebook and reviewed decisions, exact native reports/edition comparisons, complete Learning action/review cycles and revision-bound commissioned-study questions/rosters/evidence/answers. Keep investment principal separate from grant commitments and unresolved IDs visible. Register declared customer-agent inputs and independent receiving destinations. Retain complete original requests/responses and full byte artifacts. Produce separately reviewed internal/external report releases where commissioned, export full private handover and independently receive/edit/cold reopen. Record observed acceptance through existing Installation. Continue the same completed Learning workspace through hosted full-context issue, self-contained offline draft/HTML save/reopen, complete returned decisions, current-context comparison, explicit native application/rebase, original request recovery, complete cycle review and independent native-plus-exchange handover. Keep each historical edition intact.
task.completeOutput: A complete customer analysis/study edition: original source populations and meanings, explicit reviewed codebook/roster/question scope, exact reports and limitations, full Learning/evidence/action/request/release histories, approved external outputs where selected, private full source/runtime custody and independently editable receiving.
task.repeatTrigger: A distinct approved source period, changed commissioned scope or new accepted study/report edition becomes a linked task. Retrying an existing request, downloading ranges, copying or reopening its handover remains the same task.
task.pricedUnit: One agreed complete reviewed analysis/study baseline or accepted recurring edition. Preserve original integer atomic price/count/budget, spending, supplier/payment/acceptance selections. Hosting, data custody, source maintenance, research judgment and report approval remain explicit responsibilities.

source.reference: Select complete authorized private application/commission source and literal manifest/SHA; full original publisher JSON and data provenance; actual issuer roster, separate investment register, evidence/document bytes and original completed operation/inner-handover descriptors. No private case source or terms enter public integration.
source.mode: The unchanged native analyst owns source bytes, Decimal parsing/totals, codebook/reviews, edition comparisons and stable request journal. Original Learning owns full report snapshots/actions/reviews. Original Study owns revision-bound scope/questions/evidence/answers/releases. Installed HTTP/CLI/MCP attach to this same saved workspace.
source.population: Retain every selected source grant and field, original string identifiers and numeric tokens, explicit complete roster with awaiting-source entries, all investment records, evidence/document revisions, question and answer history, full Learning and audit/request populations. Preserve all unknowns and limits.
source.meaning: A source capture is not a reviewed finding. Grant commitments and investment principal remain separate and currencies are not combined. Current answers bind actual scope/question/evidence hashes; later changes require review. External releases require separately authored anonymised text and explicit disclosure review; full working handovers remain private.
source.changePolicy: Keep native requestId/action/body exact before dispatch. Replay the same committed result without overwriting later edits; changed input requires a new deliberate request. Every revision guard remains original. Failed HTTP outcomes remain full observations, not proof of no effects. Preserve original attachment keep/replace/remove semantics and immutable report IDs.

receiving.application: TJLabs Grant Analyst Workbench at products/grant-analyst-workbench; commands grant-analyst-workbench, -prepare, -managed and -receive. Complete original application source is externally supplied privately; reusable public wrappers do not redistribute it.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Verify all private source members and actual interpreter/import observations. Operate real original source review/Learning/study controls and complete customer-agent files. Bind actual completed original donor/result/inner archive, preserving distinct histories and old source. Export and independently receive full native handover, preserve later edits on exact replay and cold reopen complete history. Actually view desktop/narrow screens and all outgoing attachments/downloads. Include the exact later exchange: four explicit original requests, same-request replay, complete source/history prefix, full native ZIP and exchange bundle, independent hosted receipt reopening and cold full-file recovery. Source publication alone is not native or visual completion.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: Use existing codebook/review, Learning action, study revision and Installation change/withdraw mechanisms. Keep every prior source, decision, evidence, answer, report and request. Stop/reopen preserves the same workspace; acceptance records observed outcomes, not a generated claim.
receiving.recovery: Read full retained request/body and native saved requests/audit. Exact original mutations safely reuse stable IDs. Receive uses selected original fresh-directory reader or verified same-archive existing-target adoption; unrelated archive/target is rejected and later valid edits remain. Preserve original completed Learning separately from uncompleted commissioned work.
receiving.maintenance: Ship generic adapter code publicly and complete authorized private source/data/runtime/operating archives through existing private custody. Preserve native/source/sender/receiver owners and separate LDA reader. Source transfer, native inner handover and outer customer delivery each retain their own full inventories.

steps.title: Receive the task and original authority
steps.result: Join actual Workshare/Installation, customer question, scope/period/population, responsibility and original operation. Preserve payments and assignment selections.

steps.title: Prepare and independently receive full private source
steps.result: Validate literal authority, all application/commission members and actual selected interpreter/imports. Retain complete private source transfer.

steps.title: Review and start the original Application
steps.result: Bind source, workspace ID, Python, actor context and private connection through maintained Review/Save/Start. Preserve separate owner and per-request locks.

steps.title: Import complete publisher editions
steps.result: Retain original360Giving bytes, identifiers, numeric tokens and provenance; reuse identical editions and keep changed ones distinct.

steps.title: Review grants against an explicit codebook
steps.result: Save real questions/categories and named include/exclude decisions with source references, reasons and current codebook binding.

steps.title: Inspect full reports and source changes
steps.result: Retain exact totals by currency and complete grant-ID comparisons, including unreviewed/stale/unknown states and all original rows.

steps.title: Continue source-bound Learning cycles
steps.result: Retain full finding snapshots, accountable actions and all revision-bound reviews, interpretations and limitations without rewriting historical evidence.

steps.title: Receive full offline Learning decisions
steps.result: Issue complete current context, save/reopen offline drafts, compare returned decisions, explicitly rebase conflicts, apply through the original atomic writer/request UUID and retain every complete native receipt. Independently reopen the full native archive and exchange bundle.

steps.title: Operate actual commissioned-study scope and evidence
steps.result: Use issuer roster, separate investment principal, question/evidence/document histories and current reviewed answers including contrary evidence and open questions.

steps.title: Release selected outputs and complete handover
steps.result: Keep immutable internal working and separately authored external report releases distinct. Export full native source/workspace/history and all selected readable formats.

steps.title: Receive independently and inspect the outgoing product
steps.result: Use original complete readers, labelled technical local edits and exact request replay; cold reopen with full source/history and actually view desktop/narrow/screens/attachments.

steps.title: Record actual acceptance and next useful edition
steps.result: Save observed source/result/receiver and recipient criteria through existing Installation. Only distinct approved scope/source periods create additional tasks.
